第57章 赵素梅怀三胎了-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

在那个年代，一个不能生儿子的女人，日子有多难，林国强比谁都清楚。

李红霞骂她“不下蛋的母鸡”，周桂芳和徐青青背地里叫她“绝户”。

连村里的婆娘们都在传……林国强家的媳妇，生不了儿子。

赵素梅在人前从来不说，但林国强知道，她心里苦。

她每次看见别人家的男孩，眼神会变得黯淡。

她不是嫉妒，是遗憾，是自责。

林国强从来没怪过她。

他觉得生男生女都一样，都是他的孩子，他都疼。

但赵素梅不这么想。

她被这个家，被这个村子，被这个时代压着，觉得自己欠了林家一个儿子。

这一世，林国强不会再让那种事发生了。

“素梅，”林国强握着她的手，声音不大，但很稳，“你听我说。”

赵素梅抬起头看着他。

“从明天起，店里的事你不用管了。

你就在家好好养着，带孩子、做饭，别的什么都不用干。

地里的活我去干，店里的活有我和志军。”

“那怎么行？店里那么忙……”

“忙得过来。”林国强打断了她，“你现在的任务是养好身体，把孩子平平安安生下来。

别的都不用操心。”

赵素梅的眼眶红了，低下头，眼泪啪嗒啪嗒地掉在手背上。

“国强，”她的声音闷闷的，带着哭腔，“你对我真好。”

这年代，谁家媳妇不干活？

甚至比男人干得都多，挺着大肚子在地里干活的比比皆是。

林国强却说，以后不让她干活，安心在家养胎。

林国强伸手把她揽进怀里，下巴抵在她头顶上。

“你是我媳妇，我不对你好对谁好？”

赵素梅在他怀里哭了一会儿，哭够了，擦了擦眼泪，抬起头看着他。

“你说是个男孩还是女孩？”

“不知道。”林国强笑了，“男孩女孩都一样，我都喜欢。”

“我想要个男孩。”赵素梅的声音很小，小得像是怕被人听见。

林国强看着她，心里酸了一下。

“男孩女孩都一样。”他又说了一遍。

赵素梅没有再说什么，把脸埋进他的胸口，闭上了眼睛。

林国强搂着她，一只手轻轻地放在她的小腹上。

In that era, Lin Guoqiang knew better than anyone how difficult life was for a woman who could not give birth to a son.

Li Hongxia called her a "hen that doesn't lay eggs," while Zhou Guifang and Xu Qingqing called her a "dead household" behind their backs.

Even the women in the village are spreading rumors that...the daughter-in-law of Lin Guoqiang's family cannot give birth to a son.

Zhao Sumei never said it in front of others, but Lin Guoqiang knew that she was suffering in her heart.

Every time she sees other people's boys, her eyes become dim.

She's not jealous, she's regretful, she's remorseful.

Lin Guoqiang never blamed her.

He feels that boys and girls are the same, they are all his children, and he feels pain for them all.

But Zhao Sumei didn't think so.

She was oppressed by this family, this village, and this era, and felt that she owed the Lin family a son.

In this life, Lin Guoqiang will not let that happen again.

"Su Mei," Lin Guoqiang held her hand, his voice low but steady, "Listen to me."

Zhao Sumei raised her head and looked at him.

“From tomorrow on, you don’t have to worry about things in the store.

You just take care of yourself at home, take care of the children, cook, and don't have to do anything else.

I will do the work in the fields, and Zhijun and I will do the work in the shop."

"How can that be done? The store is so busy..."

"You're busy." Lin Guoqiang interrupted her, "Your task now is to take good care of your body and give birth to the child safely.

Don't worry about anything else."

Zhao Sumei's eyes were red, she lowered her head, tears falling on the back of her hands.

"Guoqiang," her voice was muffled and crying, "you are so good to me."

In this day and age, whose wife doesn’t work?

They even work more than men. There are many people working in the fields with their big bellies.

However, Lin Guoqiang said that she would not be allowed to work in the future and that she would be able to raise her child at home with peace of mind.

Lin Guoqiang reached out and took her into his arms, resting his chin on the top of her head.

"You are my wife, if I don't treat you well, who will I treat well?"

Zhao Sumei cried in his arms for a while. After crying enough, she wiped her tears and raised her head to look at him.

"Do you mean it's a boy or a girl?"

"I don't know." Lin Guoqiang smiled, "I like both boys and girls."

"I want a boy." Zhao Sumei's voice was very low, as if she was afraid of being heard.

Lin Guoqiang looked at her and felt sad.

"Boys and girls alike," he said again.

Zhao Sumei said nothing more, buried her face in his chest and closed her eyes.

Lin Guoqiang hugged her and gently placed one hand on her belly.
